news.title: Union Pacific conductor who recovered from stroke still posed ‘direct threat’ to safety, court rules
news.summary: Under the ADA, the railway made an “objectively reasonable” decision to restrict the conductor from driving a train, the 8th Circuit held.

news.title: DHS to propose end of 60-day grace period for H-1B visa holders
news.summary: Few details are known without the rule’s text, which has yet to be published in the Federal Register, but the change may pose difficulties for employers, one attorney said.

news.title: Labor market exhibits ‘continued resilience,’ The Conference Board finds
news.summary: Multiple factors have made an already complex job market even more volatile this year, per a report.

news.title: ‘Alienating and cruel’: EEOC files lawsuit against employer for segregating DEI training by race
news.summary: This iteration of the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission has been vocal about cracking down on DEI in the context of Title VII.

news.title: This week in 5 numbers: Employees say bosses don’t work as hard
news.summary: Here’s a roundup of numbers from the last week — including how much Apple will pay to settle U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commissions allegations.

news.title: Columbia faces discrimination lawsuit from Palestinian employees and students
news.summary: Plaintiffs allege the Ivy League institution “actively participated in and amplified” racial and political targeting of its campus members.

news.title: Brookings researchers slam assumptions in work requirements rule
news.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services are being accused of fudging the data at the center of a rule that makes it harder for Medicaid enrollees to prove they’re exempt from work requirements.

news.title: Most employers say rising healthcare costs force salary tradeoffs
news.summary: Employers cited high drug prices, high-cost claims and hospital prices as their biggest threats to affordability.

news.title: Empathetic leaders drive whether AI is seen as an opportunity or a risk, survey finds
news.summary: Empathy lifted every AI metric measured, including employee optimism and sense of control over their work, according to a Businessolver report.

news.title: Mile Hi Foods settles for $1.5M over alleged refusal to hire women, Black and Afghan workers
news.summary: The complaint alleged that when the HR manager opposed these practices, Mile Hi unlawfully retaliated by harassing and ultimately discharging her.
